key_idea: Swapping two equal letters is indistinguishable from doing nothing, so the trick works iff all letters are distinct.
sketch: Check whether the string has a repeated character with a set; print 1 if all distinct, else 0. Any swap of two different letters changes exactly two positions and is uniquely identifiable, so distinctness is also sufficient. O(|s|). A single-card string is trivially 1.
